Definition: from a collateral form of G138; capture:--be taken.
BiblicalUsage: Halosis means being taken, caught like an animal in a trap, and Peter uses it once, for false teachers who speak evil of things they do not understand. In 2 Peter 2:12 he calls them brute beasts made to be taken and destroyed, and says they will perish in their own corruption.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning is plain: a mind that mocks what it refuses to understand is already caught.
